business: Union Square House Real Estate Brokers
summary: A Sheikh Zayed Road brokerage appears to lose buyers and landlords to visible template code and a site that shows only a contact page.

findings.problem: Template code such as {search} and {{title}} appears in the page text.
findings.cost: Code on a broker page makes the firm look unfinished.
findings.fix: Clean template with no leftover code.

findings.problem: The site appears to show only a contact form and address, with no listings, services or team on the page.
findings.cost: Property buyers and owners cannot see what you sell or who you are.
findings.fix: Featured listings, services and team on the homepage.

findings.problem: The site appears to run on a free Weebly address, with a footer that says Powered by Create your own unique website.
findings.cost: A builder advert in the footer looks temporary for a brokerage.
findings.fix: Your own domain and a branded footer.

findings.problem: A fax number appears but no WhatsApp does.
findings.cost: Property enquiries in Dubai usually start on WhatsApp.
